providers.name: Apify (platform + Apify Store actors)

pricing.model: Monthly platform plan with prepaid usage, plus pay-per-event prices set per actor
pricing.public_price_points: Plans: Free $0 (includes $5 usage/month), Starter $19/month, Scale $199/month, Business $999/month. Actor event prices at the Bronze (Starter) tier: Amazon Product Scraper (junglee/Amazon-crawler, Apify-maintained) $0.004 per result, +$0.002 per offer, +$0.002 per seller, +$0.05 per delivery-location lookup; Amazon Reviews Scraper (junglee) $0.005 per review; E-commerce Scraping Tool (apify) $0.0015 per product detail, $0.00042 per listing row, optional per-product add-ons $0.001 residential proxy, $0.00057 browser rendering, $0.0015 unblocker proxy; community actors for Noon, Takealot, Jumia, Flipkart, Nykaa, Shopee, Lazada, Tesco, Boots, Target, Ulta roughly $0.0004-$0.008 per result.
pricing.free_tier: Free plan: $5 of usage per month, no credit card.

providers.delivery: REST API, scheduled runs, datasets (JSON/CSV/Excel), webhooks and integrations
providers.historical_data: None native; some community actors offer change-tracking/monitor modes. History must be built by storing snapshots.
providers.compliance_posture: Marketplace model: each actor has its own maintainer. Apify's own article says scraping publicly available data is generally legal, that GDPR protects all personal data regardless of source, and that sites can restrict scraping contractually. The Apify-maintained Amazon Reviews Scraper excludes personal information by default (input 'Include personal information', default false).
providers.limitations: Quality and continuity vary by actor. Usage on 2026-11-26: Amazon Product Scraper 33,843 total / 3,145 monthly users; Amazon Reviews Scraper 18,795 / 2,351 (rating 2.7 of 5 from 46 ratings); long-tail actors are tiny (e.g. Takealot 59 / 10, Jumia 75 / 15, Nykaa 20 / 16, Boots 26 / 7 monthly users) and community-maintained. No actor retrieved lists amazon.co.za explicitly (the Apify-maintained actors accept any Amazon URL/domain string). The Apify-maintained Amazon ASINs actor exposes an optional CAPTCHA solver (default off). Amazon review depth is limited (official actor: max 100 reviews per star filter; one community actor states that since Oct 2026 amazon.com returns summary/excerpts only without login).

providers.name: Bright Data (Web Scraper API and datasets)

pricing.model: Pay per successful record (Web Scraper API); one-off or subscription dataset purchases
pricing.public_price_points: Web Scraper API: pay-as-you-go $1.5 per 1,000 records; Scale plan $499/month including 384,000 records, then $1.3 per 1,000; Enterprise custom. Custom/AI-built scrapers (Shopee, Noon pages): $1.5 per 1,000 page loads, Scale $499/month with 383K page loads. Datasets: e-commerce datasets start at $250 for 100,000 records (one-time), discounts for biannual/quarterly/monthly refresh.
pricing.free_tier: Free tier: 5,000 records (or page loads) per month, no credit card.

providers.delivery: API (sync/async), datasets; delivery to Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure, Snowflake, Google Pub/Sub, SFTP, webhook; JSON/NDJSON/CSV/Parquet
providers.historical_data: Yes for datasets (pre-collected snapshots; one-time or scheduled refresh). The API itself is real-time.
providers.compliance_posture: States 'Only publicly available data', 'GDPR & CCPA compliant', 'ISO 27001 certified, SOC 2 controls', and that every use case is reviewed by a Compliance & Ethics team; Trust Center references a KYC process, a public SOC 3 report and certificates. Vendor claims, not independently verified.
providers.limitations: Pages retrieved name Amazon (amazon.com, with amazon.co.uk and amazon.de in samples), Walmart, Target, Lazada, Shopee, Flipkart and Noon, but not Tesco, Ulta, Boots, Takealot, Jumia or Nykaa; Amazon regional domains (.ae, .sa, .in, .co.za) and Shopee/Lazada country sites are not itemised. Whether a search page is billed as one record or one record per product row was not stated on the pages retrieved. Amazon review depth not stated. In Meta v. Bright Data the plaintiff alleged the company uses tools to get past CAPTCHAs.

providers.name: Oxylabs (Web Scraper API - dedicated commerce scrapers)

pricing.model: Prepaid monthly plans; price per 1,000 successful results depends on target and JavaScript rendering
pricing.public_price_points: Plans: Starter $15/month, Basic $100/month, Flexible $500/month, Enterprise from $2,500/month. Per 1,000 results: Amazon (non-JS) $0.50 falling to $0.25 at volume; other targets from $1.00; custom domain non-JS $1.00, with JS rendering $1.50.

providers.delivery: REST API with sync, async and batch modes; parsed JSON for dedicated targets
providers.compliance_posture: States the E-Commerce Scraper is ISO/IEC 27001:2017 certified and describes the product as extracting publicly-available product data.
providers.limitations: Dedicated endpoints documented for Amazon ('A URL on any Amazon marketplace': product, search, pricing, sellers, bestsellers), Walmart, Target, Flipkart and Lazada (product and search). No dedicated endpoint found for Noon, Takealot, Jumia, Nykaa, Shopee, Boots, Tesco or Ulta (generic 'custom domain' scraping only). No Amazon reviews endpoint appears in the current commerce reference; Oxylabs' own blog says non-logged-in users see roughly 8 to 13 featured reviews.

providers.name: Zyte API
data_types: product detail page (AI extraction: name, SKU, GTIN, brand, price, currency, availability, aggregate rating)

pricing.model: Pay per 1,000 successful responses; price depends on a per-website difficulty tier and on browser rendering
pricing.public_price_points: HTTP responses: $0.13 (tier 1) to $1.27 (tier 5) per 1,000 pay-as-you-go; browser-rendered: $1.01 to $16.08 per 1,000. Monthly commitments of $100, $200 or $500 lower the unit rates. Cost of AI extraction add-ons is not listed on the pricing page.

providers.delivery: REST API; managed 'Zyte Data' feeds delivered to specification
providers.compliance_posture: States 'Product feeds do not collect personal data', that every project is reviewed against its ethical web data principles, and that it is a founding member of the Ethical Web Data Collection Initiative; displays an ISO 27001 seal.
providers.limitations: No marketplace-specific endpoints were found: every target is handled through generic extraction, and the price tier for each marketplace is only visible in Zyte's cost calculator. Suitable where no dedicated scraper exists, but output must be validated per site.

providers.name: ScraperAPI (structured data endpoints)
data_types: product detail page (Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Home Depot)
search results (Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Home Depot)

pricing.model: Monthly plans of API credits; credits per request vary by domain
pricing.public_price_points: Hobby $49/month (100,000 credits), Startup $149 (1,000,000), Business $299 (3,000,000), Scaling $475 (5,000,000), Professional $975 (10,500,000), Advanced $1,975 (21,500,000). A standard page costs 1 credit; Amazon, Walmart and eBay cost 5 credits per request; premium or JS rendering 10 credits; ultra-premium 30.
pricing.free_tier: Pricing page offers a 7-day trial with 5,000 credits; its FAQ also describes a free plan with 1,000 credits (the two are not reconciled on the page).

providers.delivery: REST API (sync and async endpoints); DataPipeline scheduled jobs
providers.compliance_posture: No compliance statement was found on the pages retrieved.
providers.limitations: Documented Amazon domains include com, co.uk, in, ae, sa and co.za. The current documentation index lists Amazon Product, Search and Offers endpoints but no Amazon reviews endpoint (a marketing page still shows one). All other target sites are generic scraping only.

providers.name: SerpApi
data_types: search results with position and sponsored flag (Amazon, Walmart, Target, eBay, Google Shopping)

pricing.model: Monthly plans by number of successful searches (one request = one search regardless of result count)
pricing.public_price_points: Free 250 searches/month; Starter $25 (1,000); Developer $75 (5,000); Production $150 (15,000); Big Data $275 (30,000); Searcher $725 (100,000).

providers.delivery: REST API (JSON); async mode with a Searches Archive API
providers.historical_data: Only an archive of the customer's own past searches.
providers.compliance_posture: Advertises a 'U.S. Legal Shield' of up to $2 million covering the scraping and parsing of search engine data 'as long as your use of the data or service is not illegal'.
providers.limitations: Engine-specific: 22 Amazon domains listed (amazon.co.za is not among them); Target is search-only; no engines for Noon, Takealot, Jumia, Flipkart, Nykaa, Shopee, Lazada, Boots, Tesco or Ulta and no generic scraping endpoint. No dedicated Amazon reviews engine was listed. Google sued SerpApi in December 2025 under the DMCA anti-circumvention provisions (status not verified).

pricing.public_price_points: Hobbyist $23/month (500 credits), Starter $83 (10,000), Production $375 (250,000), BigData $1,000 (1,000,000); extra credits $0.06, $0.0118, $0.003 and $0.002 respectively. Credits consumed per request type are not stated on the pricing page.
pricing.free_tier: Free trial offered; allowance not stated.

providers.delivery: REST API (JSON/CSV/HTML); 'Collections' for scheduled bulk requests
providers.compliance_posture: Describes its data as web-scraped from public sources; no certification statement found on the pages retrieved.
providers.limitations: Amazon only. Supported-domain list includes amazon.com, .co.uk, .ae, .sa, .in and .co.za. Current status of the reviews request type could not be confirmed from Traject documentation (the documentation page returned 404; third-party user reviews report failures) - UNVERIFIED.

pricing.public_price_points: Starter $66/month (10,000 credits), Production $375 (250,000), BigData $1,000 (1,000,000); the page also mentions a plan from $15/month for 500 credits.

providers.name: Keepa API

pricing.model: Monthly subscription by token generation rate (tokens per minute)
pricing.public_price_points: Official pricing page could not be read (site blocked automated access). A third-party article updated 2026-08-20 reports EUR 49 for 20 tokens/minute, EUR 129 for 60, EUR 459 for 250, EUR 879 for 500, EUR 2,499 for 2,000 and EUR 11,099 for 10,000 - treat as UNVERIFIED until confirmed on keepa.com.

data_types: LLM-based JSON extraction to a user-defined schema

pricing.model: Monthly credit plans; 1 credit per page, +4 credits for JSON extraction
pricing.free_tier: 1,000 credits per month, no credit card.

providers.limitations: General-purpose crawler aimed at AI use; no marketplace-specific parsers, so price/rank fields must be defined and validated by the user. Success on protected marketplaces not verified.

data_types: reviews (Amazon reviews endpoint marked legacy / high-risk)

pricing.public_price_points: Starter $99/month (100,000 credits), Standard $249 (300,000), Professional $499 (750,000), Enterprise $999 (2,000,000). Amazon US: 1 credit per request; other Amazon marketplaces: 2.5 credits; Unblock API with premium proxy: 2 credits.

Its Amazon reviews documentation states that since 5 November 2024 Amazon requires login to view reviews, that only the 8 most recent reviews are available without supplying an Amazon account cookie, and that the endpoint is 'legacy / high-risk'.
